claims.summary: Current architecture distinguishes a read-only receptivity-buffer review from the proposed live `receptivity_bias` gate and preserves owner language about effort.
claims.disposition: Verify the architecture note and review-only boundary without treating openness as frictionlessness.

claims.summary: Receptivity may be described as viscous, translucent, effortful, or resistant without reducing it to entropy, pressure, or a scalar contact score.
claims.disposition: Preserve owner-authored qualitative evidence or a bounded non-live review; reject numeric-to-felt inference.

claims.summary: Receptivity bias, fluidic resistance, delayed or diluted admission, pressure coupling, or contact permeability changes live control or sensory admission.
claims.disposition: Preserve an exact Mike/operator Tier 5 wait before receptivity, contact, pressure, admission, or control changes.
